exposure: Flamm and Geiger score at a cut point of 5
outcome: trial of labor after cesarean section rate
success rate of vaginal birth after one lower uterine transverse cesarean section
cohort: 408 women with a trial of labor after one lower uterine transverse cesarean section from January 1/2020 to December 31/2020
finding: Maternal age, prior vaginal birth, non-recurring indication for C-section, ruptured membrane, cervical dilatation, cervical effacement, and low station at admission were associated with successful vaginal birth after one lower uterine transverse cesarean section.
